RELATION: param-dependency | APIS: make_first_score_manager(), make_last_score_manager() | RULE: The score hook mode (FIRST or LAST) is determined by which function is used to create the manager.

RELATION: return-flow | APIS: sp.hooks.score(value), sp.plugins_context(plugins) | RULE: The result of sp.hooks.score(value) must be passed into sp.plugins_context(plugins) for it to have any effect.

RELATION: shared-receiver | APIS: sp, wrapper.enable(), wrapper.disable() | RULE: All calls related to a single plugin (e.g., enabling or disabling) must be made on the same Simplug manager object.

RELATION: config-return-contract | APIS: make_score_manager(), make_first_score_manager(), make_last_score_manager() | RULE: The return type and shape of the functions are determined by whether they use make_score_manager, make_first_score_manager, or make_last_score_manager.

RELATION: lifecycle | APIS: sp.disable(*names), sp.enable(*names) | RULE: Plugin enabling and disabling must be done within the same Simplug manager's lifecycle to take effect.

RELATION: completion-obligation | APIS: sp.hooks.score(value), sp.get_plugin(name).disable() | RULE: A call to sp.hooks.score(value) must be paired with a call to disable or enable on a plugin wrapper to have any observable effect.
---
RELATION: param-dependency | APIS: make_score_manager(), make_first_score_manager(), make_last_score_manager() | RULE: The choice of which API to use determines the behavior of the score hook, specifically whether it returns the first or last result.
---
RELATION: param-dependency | APIS: make_first_score_manager(), make_last_score_manager() | RULE: The result mode of the score hook is determined by which function is used to create the manager (FIRST or LAST).

RELATION: return-flow | APIS: sp.hooks.score(value), sp.plugins_context(plugins) | RULE: The results returned by sp.hooks.score(value) must be passed into the plugins_context context manager for processing.

RELATION: shared-receiver | APIS: sp, wrapper.enable(), wrapper.disable() | RULE: Both operations (enabling and disabling a plugin) must be performed on the same Simplug manager object.

RELATION: config-return-contract | APIS: make_score_manager(), make_first_score_manager(), make_last_score_manager() | RULE: The return type or shape of the manager is determined by which function is used to create it (standard, first, or last result mode).

RELATION: lifecycle | APIS: sp.disable(*names), sp.enable(*names) | RULE: Plugin enabling and disabling operations must be performed within a valid Simplug manager context.

RELATION: completion-obligation | APIS: sp.hooks.score(value), wrapper.disable() | RULE: A call to sp.hooks.score(value) must be paired with an appropriate discharge call (e.g., disabling a plugin) to take effect.
